title: Dartmouth Taiwanese Student Association
content_html:
The Dartmouth Taiwanese Student Association (TSA) is the current Taiwanese student organization at Dartmouth College in Hanover, New Hampshire. It is listed under its full name — Dartmouth Taiwanese Student Association — in the official DartmouthGroups platform, which serves as the college’s central hub for recognized student organizations. The organization is also listed among groups advised by Dartmouth’s Office of Pluralism and Leadership (OPAL), which supports pan-Asian student organizations on campus.

A Facebook group titled “Dartmouth TSA 達特茅斯台灣同學會” (facebook.com/groups/124380587668713) is associated with the organization, indicating a community presence with a Chinese-language name. No dedicated website, Instagram account, or Linktree was identified through available first-party sources. No founding year or official mission statement could be confirmed from first-party sources.

Note: A predecessor organization, the Dartmouth Taiwanese Association (DTA), was founded in 1995 but went inactive in 1999, according to a Dartmouth course research exhibit. The current Dartmouth Taiwanese Student Association appears to be a distinct, separately formed organization.
